# MacroTrace

MacroTrace is a local-first, registry-constrained white-box US macro research compiler.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/ZhenyuanPAN822/macrotrace
English documentation: /README.md
Chinese documentation: /README.zh-CN.md
Architecture: /docs/04_architecture_v02.md
Report reverse workflow: /docs/08_report_ingestion_workflow_v1.md
API schema: /schemas/research_job.schema.json

Important boundaries:
- LLMs route and interpret registered evidence; Python performs numeric analysis.
- The runtime must not generate or modify statistical code.
- Predictive or associational evidence must not be described as identified causality.
- Credentials, user research history, raw private reports, and local databases are excluded from source control.
